Package neqsim.thermo.util.mercury

Class MercuryFluidConverter

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.util.mercury.MercuryFluidConverter
public final class MercuryFluidConverter extends Object
Converts a fluid to the UMR-PRU-MC model for mercury studies.

Process studies are normally made with a characterized fluid from an Eclipse E300 file, read with EclipseFluidReadWrite as a Peng-Robinson or SRK fluid. That model has no mercury parameters. This class builds a SystemUMRPRUMCEos fluid with the same components and amounts, and optionally a given mercury content, so that the same process can be calculated with mercury.

  • Components from the NeqSim database are added by name and use the database parameters of UMR-PRU-MC.
  • Pseudo-components (TBP and plus fractions) keep the critical temperature, critical pressure, acentric factor, molar mass, density and volume correction of the source fluid. They have no Mathias-Copeman parameters and therefore use the Peng-Robinson alpha function, and their UNIFAC groups are CH2 groups from the molar mass.
  • Binary interaction parameters of the source fluid are not used; UMR-PRU-MC uses its UNIFAC group parameters.

The phase behaviour of the converted fluid is therefore close to, but not the same as, that of the source fluid. Compare the main stream flows of the two models before using the mercury results. Glycols are outside the range of the mercury parameters.

    • toUmrPruMc

      public static SystemInterface toUmrPruMc(SystemInterface fluid, double mercuryContent, String unit)
      Convert a fluid to UMR-PRU-MC and give it a mercury content.

      The content refers to the whole fluid. To match a mercury content measured in one phase of a process stream, for example in the gas from a separator, run the process, read the calculated content of that phase and scale the content given here by measured over calculated; mercury below saturation distributes in proportion to the feed content.

      Parameters:
      fluid - fluid with any equation of state, for example read from an E300 file
      mercuryContent - mercury content of the whole fluid; mercury already in the fluid is replaced. Zero gives a fluid without mercury.
      unit - "mole fraction", "ppb" (mole fraction times 1e9), "ug/Sm3" (per standard cubic metre of the fluid as ideal gas at 15 C and 1.01325 bara), "ug/Nm3" (0 C and 1.01325 bara) or "ug/kg" (per kilogram of the fluid)
      Returns:
      new UMR-PRU-MC fluid with the same components, amounts, temperature and pressure, with the UMR-PRU mixing rule set and multiphase check enabled
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the fluid is null, the content is negative or not finite, the unit is not supported or the fluid has a component that UMR-PRU-MC does not support
